field.label: Enabled
field.help: Block the devices listed. Off, the rules are gone at the next filter reload; the list stays.

field.label: Log blocked packets
field.help: Write every packet the rules block to the firewall log.

field.label: Isolate devices that reach a command-and-control list
field.help: When os-netreport records that a device of your networks tried to reach an address on a command-and-control list that os-blocklists blocks, the device is isolated by its MAC address: nothing it sends passes the firewall and nothing reaches it through the firewall, for the time below, and its open connections are cut. Checked every minute, for connections in the last 10 minutes. Never the firewall itself, its gateways, or an address this page was opened from. A device os-netreport knows no MAC address of is not isolated. Separate from the list of blocked devices and from Enabled above. Off by default.

field.label: Isolation time (hours)
field.help: How long a device stays isolated, from 1 to 720 hours. Undo on the Isolated devices tab lets it go at once.
